comments.body: Built on factory/muster-1119-iris (918df413, e92dfebf, eced1f27). A messaging request whose MUSTER_PANE names a closed or unknown pane, and that carries no --as and no inbox of its own, is refused with pane_closed instead of being taken as the person's; the error names --as. The lead chose refusing over keeping the closed pane's identity (smaller, no new state). Reviewed by Claude Opus; its finding (the refusal also blocked --as senders) is fixed in eced1f27. Gate green.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
A launcher's exit handler ran `muster msg post --to pollen` after its helper pane (jigsaw) had been closed with `pane close`. The message arrived in `@human+pollen` from `@human`, not in `jigsaw+pollen` from the helper. Posting as the person when the pane named by `MUSTER_PANE` is gone puts words in the owner's mouth.

Refuse posts whose `MUSTER_PANE` names a closed pane, or keep the closed pane's identity. From tooling feedback a_30ZbKPQ6t.
title: A post from a closed pane's environment is attributed to @human
